problem: The deployed maintenance config rejected every merchant with more than one matching integration document. behavior.single_record: Preserve existing exact-owner behavior, including missing or legacy string updated_at; no ordering choice exists.
behavior.multiple_records: Use the unchanged unfiltered merchant string/integer query sorted by updated_at descending, limited to the top two. Require a real datetime winner; a datetime runner must be strictly older after UTC normalization. Exact scalar string or null/missing runners are known lower BSON ranks and are accepted without parsing. Refuse equal dates, non-date winners, arrays and unsupported ranking shapes. Require the winning user_id to exactly equal the authenticated owner; never fall back to a convenient caller-owned record.
